---
name: representation-text-font-size-underestimation
description: Prevention strategy for text-font-size-underestimation.
---

Compare rendered glyph height and line extent with the reference when calibrating text styles; if resizing the text box has no effect, correct the local font size.

Match heading glyph height and occupied width to the reference independently of the text-box dimensions.

Candidate only; promote after controlled probe validation.
